description: Defines a templated expiring cache class with customizable expiration policies and eviction handling, including an internal iterator class.

classes.name: NoopEvictionHandler
classes.description: A default eviction handler that performs no action.

classes.name: ExpiringCache
classes.description: A cache that stores entries with explicit expiration policies, supporting custom expiration comparison and eviction handling.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value if it exists and is not expired.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Inserts or updates a cache entry with expiration.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the cache.

methods.name: max_entries
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of entries allowed in the cache.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the cache is empty.

methods.name: Compact
methods.description: Removes expired or excess entries to maintain size constraints.

methods.name: Evict
methods.description: Removes a specific entry and calls the eviction handler.
